newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-MARK WAUGH HITS BACK WITH 173.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MARK WAUGH HITS BACK WITH 173.

text.p: Mark Waugh ended a poor run of form with a classy 173 to give Australia a 309-run first innings lead on the second day of their three-day match against Hampshire on Sunday.
Waugh, who has made just 90 runs in his past six innings, hit three sixes and 22 fours in his first tour century before being caught at slip off Simon Renshaw.
Captain Mark Taylor also continued his return to form, moving on from his overnight score of 61 to post his second tour hundred.
Taylor and Waugh put on 157 for the third wicket in 36 overs before Taylor fell for 109 to John Stephenson.
Australia declared at 465 for eight and Hampshire reached 71 for two in their second innings at the close.
